title: Senior Account Executive (Hunter) — Dados, Governança & IA
description:
Sobre a Apgar

Somos uma consultoria especializada em Data Management, Governança de Dados e Inteligência Artificial , com presença global e reconhecimento do mercado. Atuamos de ponta a ponta — de estratégia e governança até a implementação e operação de soluções de Analytics, MDM, Data Platform e AI — ajudando organizações a transformar dados em valor de negócio sustentável.


Além de serviços, temos ofertas proprietárias e aceleradores (como o ApgarIA para manufatura e supply chain (produção, previsão de demanda, agentes de IA, etc.) — e um portfólio robusto de casos e parcerias tecnológicas que ampliam o impacto nos clientes.


O que Oferecemos:


  • Ambiente global com equipes em 4 continentes
  • Empresa reconhecida internacionalmente, com metodologias próprias, ofertas de AI e stack tecnológica ampla para construir soluções de alto impacto.
  • Somos certificados Great Place to Work no Brasil ,
  • Oferecemos trilhas de formação contínua e coaching de carreira ; cultura colaborativa e meritocrática.
  • Pacote competitivo (salário + variável) e benefícios, com flexibilidade e possibilidade de atuação remota/híbrida.


Local de Trabalho: São Paulo ou Porto Alegre (modelo híbrido/remoto)


Responsabilidades:

Buscamos um(a) hunter nato(a) , apaixonado(a) por Account-Based Selling/Marketing (ABS/ABM) , para abrir novos logos enterprise (médias e grandes contas) que investem em Dados, Governança e IA . Você vai liderar o ciclo comercial completo, da prospecção executiva ao fechamento, orquestrando a proposta de valor da Apgar e conectando-a às dores reais dos clientes.


O que você vai vender


  • Consultoria para programas de Governança de Dados e Estratégia de Dados .
  • Apgar Pathfinder (nossa metodologia para aceleração e priorização de Dados e IA, quick wins/MVP e roadmap integrado entre valor de negócio, fundações de dados e plataforma).
  • Licenças de parceiros líderes de mercado (ex.: Soluções de MDM, Data Catalog, BI, Plataformas de Dados)
  • Serviços de Implementação de soluções MDM , Data Catalog e Plataformas de Dados (ex.: Databricks, Snowflake), além de Analytics & AI .
  • Produtos e Aceleradores Apgar
  • Serviços de Sustentação das soluções implementadas


Principais responsabilidades

  • Hunting com ABS/ABM: mapear contas-alvo, identificar buying centers (C-level, Data Leaders, TI, Operações) e conduzir abordagens multithread.
  • Prospecção executiva: construir relacionamento consultivo, qualificar dores (valor, risco, eficiência), definir hipóteses de valor e próximos passos.
  • Arquitetar a proposta de valor: liderar a coordenação de propostas (escopo, storytelling, casos de uso/ROI, investimento), orquestrando times técnicos para estimativas e demonstrações .
  • Pilotar o funil e forecast: gerir pipeline no CRM, definir e acompanhar plays com o(a) SDR (lista-alvo, mensagens, MQL→SQL), e garantir cadência de reuniões qualificadas.
  • Parcerias: trabalhar com parceiros tecnológicos na conquista de novos negócios.
  • Representar a Apgar em eventos do ecossistema de dados/IA .


Perfil que buscamos

  • Hunter com histórico consistente de abertura de novos logos enterprise em serviços consultoria de dados/IA, governança, MDM ou plataformas de dados.
  • Linguagem de negócio + fluência técnica : fala com CDO/CIO/COO e também debate em bom nível com equipes de dados e governança (sem precisar ser “mão no código”).
  • ABS/ABM practitioner : sabe montar account plans , mapear poder/influência, criar value hypotheses e navegar ciclos complexos.
  • Experiente na Orquestração de propostas ponta a ponta, com ownership da narrativa de valor e da negociação .
  • Networking ativo no ecossistema corporativo de Dados, TI e AI no Brasil/LatAm capaz de gerar pipeline.
  • Comunicação impecável (português) e inglês/espanhol valorizados para LatAm.


Diferenciais que contam pontos

  • Casos vendidos/entregues envolvendo MDM (Customer/Product 360) , Catálogo de Dados, Programas Governança , Databricks/Snowflake , AI/ML .
  • Vivência em metodologias de valor e roadmap (ex.: priorização esforço×impacto, MVP, “from business value to foundations & platform”).
  • Experiência com ApgarIA ou ofertas de AI para Operações (manufatura/supply chain, agentes de IA, otimização).


Como medimos sucesso (primeiros 6–12 meses)

  • Novos logos qualificados e fechados (mid-large/enterprise).
  • Pipeline saudável (cobertura, taxa de conversão, ciclo médio).
  • MVPs/PoVs vendidos com tese de valor clara (Pathfinder → MVP → roll-out).
  • Ativação de parceiros e geração de oportunidades conjuntas.



Apgar Group é um empregador de igualdade de oportunidades e valoriza a diversidade em nossa empresa. Não discriminamos com base em raça, religião, cor, nacionalidade, gênero, orientação sexual, idade, estado civil ou deficiência.

title: PS Systems Engineer
description:
Bradford Jacobs has partnered with an award-winning Technology Solution Provider dedicated to protecting and empowering organizations across the central U.S. They deliver innovative, business-aligned solutions in cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, Microsoft, Salesforce, and support services.


As a Systems Engineer, you’ll play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting complex IT systems for enterprise clients. You’ll work hands-on with modern infrastructure technologies, collaborate with internal engineering teams, and provide expert guidance to help organizations optimize their IT environments.


This role suits a proactive, self-driven engineer who enjoys direct client engagement and thrives in a dynamic, solution-oriented setting.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, install, configure, and support systems technologies, including servers, storage, and Active Directory.
  • Consult with clients on integrating new technologies into existing infrastructures.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to deliver tailored business solutions for critical environments.
  • Manage and resolve client support tickets, maintaining clear communication and documentation.
  • Track time against project agreements to ensure service efficiency and profitability.
  • Report on project progress and participate in ongoing technical training and development.


Skills & Experience

  • 3–4 years of Systems Engineering experience in enterprise or managed service environments.
  • 3–4 years of hands-on experience with Microsoft 365.
  • Strong background in Intune and mobile device management.
  • Proficiency with MFA and/or Single Sign-On solutions.
  • Solid understanding of Windows Server and desktop operating systems.
  • Proven ability to develop and maintain detailed systems documentation.
  • Familiarity with change management, product lifecycles, and client service best practices.


This is a fully remote position, on a B2B contract basis, paying up to USD20 per hour

title: Desenvolvedor Fullstack (Python/React) Senior
description:
Na Jaya Tech, acreditamos na Engenharia de Software Consciente, uma abordagem inovadora, e por isso oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho inspirador, focado em promover o autoconhecimento, tomar decisões embasadas em dados, cultivar relacionamentos saudáveis e entender o impacto do nosso trabalho. Aqui, você encontrará oportunidades para crescimento profissional e pessoal, contribuindo para projetos que têm um impacto significativo na indústria e na sociedade.


Sobre o Projeto

Você fará parte de um time de uma empresa do segmento que desenvolve tecnologia para o setor de seguros.


Atuação 100% remota | Ingles Fluente | Forma de contratação: Contractor | Reuneração: Dólar | Full-time


Requisitos Necessários

Senioridade em desenvolvimento Fullstack

Product thinking — importante discutir soluções e não apenas executar tarefas

Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma e contribuir com desenho arquitetural

Comunicação confortável em inglês

Experiência sólida com JavaScript + TypeScript

Domínio de React (principal linguagem no frontend)

Experiência em gerenciamento de chamadas a REST APIs

Conhecimento em testes unitários e de UI no frontend

Ferramentas de frontend: Eslint, Prettier, bundle optimization, Sonarcloud

Experiência sólida em Python (principal linguagem backend)

Vivência em AWS Cloud (Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, Kubernetes, Kafka/Queues)

Experiência em sistemas distribuídos, microsserviços e arquitetura orientada a eventos


Requisitos Desejáveis

Experiência com React Native

Vivência com soluções de data/state management diferentes de Redux e Context API

Experiência com Java como linguagem complementar


Responsabilidades

Atuar no desenvolvimento fullstack, contribuindo tanto no frontend (React/TypeScript) quanto no backend (Python/AWS)

Participar ativamente da discussão de soluções, aplicando product thinking e propondo alternativas técnicas viáveis

Contribuir para o desenho da arquitetura do novo produto, incluindo microsserviços e sistemas distribuídos

Desenvolver e manter aplicações frontend com foco em qualidade, performance e testabilidade

Criar e dar manutenção em serviços backend em Python, com uso de AWS Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, K8s e Kafka/Queues

Garantir a qualidade do código e das entregas, assumindo responsabilidade pelos testes automatizados (unitários, UI e integração)

Trabalhar de forma autônoma, colaborando com o time na definição de padrões e boas práticas

Otimizar e monitorar aplicações, aplicando práticas de event-driven architecture e escalabilidade em nuvem

Colaborar em um ambiente ágil, mantendo comunicação clara em inglês com o time e stakeholders

description:
Descrição da vaga

  • Analisar, planejar e executar desenvolvimento e/ou manutenção de soluções de GIS/TI nas fases de Design, Construção, Tecnologia, Requisitos, Teste, Infraestrutura, Configuração e Qualidade.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Escrever códigos de desenvolvimento dos sistemas seguindo padrões de nomenclatura e práticas da empresa;
  • Detalhar projetos, determinando suas interfaces, limites de automação e plataforma tecnológica;
  • Construir modelos funcionais e de dados de sistemas, aplicando boas práticas que garantam visão estruturada, qualidade, reutilização, facilidade de manutenção de códigos;
  • Identificar, avaliar e definir frameworks, componentes e softwares para desenvolvimento, por meio de conceituação, documentação e experimentação, buscando aprimorar as soluções desenvolvidas;
  • Realizar avaliações de segurança e performance de soluções;
  • Aplicar e avaliar testes funcionais e não funcionais, seguindo o plano de testes estabelecido junto ao cliente visando a entrega da solução e satisfação do cliente;
  • Apoio a criação do plano de testes funcionais e não funcionais visando a entrega da solução e satisfação do cliente;
  • Avaliar e elaborar a documentação técnica dos sistemas desenvolvidos e os repositórios de informação dos projetos, de forma suficiente à posterior compreensão da atividade executada;
  • Assegurar as interfaces de integração com outras plataformas/soluções.
  • Cumprir as diretrizes de segurança da informação estabelecidas pelo Grupo Imagem.
  • Desenvolver os trabalhos de depuração e testes de programa, executando serviços de manutenção nos programas já existentes identificando as causas de erros e realizar as correções necessárias a fim de obter os padrões de qualidade estabelecidos;
  • Receber a especificação funcional para desenvolvimento, melhoria e manutenção de softwares, avaliar e estimar o tempo necessário para execução de acordo com o previsto na proposta técnica;
  • Realizar testes básicos da codificação efetuada, de acordo com as instruções contidas na especificação, de forma a minimizar a propagação de erros para a fase de testes;
  • Entender e discutir a estratégia de codificação com o Especialista e/ou Analista da equipe e codificar a solução de software necessária para atender o recurso definido para o produto seguindo as diretrizes, políticas e estratégias da empresa;
  • Apoiar na realização de testes automatizados, unidade, integração, desempenho etc.
  • Aplicar procedimentos definidos no Processo de Desenvolvimento, com base nas especificações detalhadas das funcionalidades a serem criadas no projeto;
  • Transformar requisitos em um sistema pronto, bem como realizar as fases de elaboração de requisitos e da programação de sistemas; Conhecer tecnicamente as fases das atividades, identificar e orientar a solução de problemas;
  • Utilizar a ferramenta e os procedimentos estabelecidos no Processo de Desenvolvimento da empresa para reportar problemas encontrados, indicar o progresso das suas atividades, apontar horas trabalhadas e demais informações aplicáveis;
  • Contribuir na estimativa de novas funcionalidades e na avaliação do impacto de novos requisitos a projetos, com relação à complexidade e viabilidade do esforço da implementação desenvolvida.
  • Atuar em conjunto com o time de negócio com o objetivo de desenhar e desenvolver;
  • Entender, criar, manipular e consultar bancos de dados visando a execução das etapas de desenvolvimento do programa;
  • Corrigir e propor melhorias em bugs, bem como desenvolver novas funcionalidades para os sistemas propondo soluções/melhorias e realizar a implantação das funcionalidades em ambientes;
  • Definir soluções técnicas de acordo com a tecnologia utilizada nos projetos em desenvolvimento, através da produção de código limpo e eficiente;
  • Participar do sprint para elaboração do plano de trabalho e distribuição das atividades, bem como programar, implementar e manter rotinas;
  • Alinhar com o gestor a demanda, funcionalidades e aplicação nas operações de desenvolvimento;
  • Projetar e desenvolver APIs de integração capazes de lidar com alto volume de dados;
  • Buscar novas ferramentas e técnicas para a melhoria contínua de nossos sistemas;
  • Cumprir as diretrizes de segurança da informação e compliance estabelecidas pelo Grupo Imagem.


Requisitos e qualificações:

Formação :

  • Graduando ou Graduado.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de software e desenvolvimento seguro;
  • Experiência trabalhando com serviços restfull e/ou microserviços;
  • Conhecimentos em html5, CSS3, node.js, angular, vue e react, Java, Sprint boot, SQL;
  • Experiência em levantar e documentar requisitos juntos aos usuários;
  • Capacidade de realizar testes unitários e de integração;
  • Capacidade de desenvolvimento de soluções utilizando as linguagens.


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Certificações;
  • Inglês Intermediário/Avançado;
  • Vivência em metodologias ágeis;
  • Conhecimentos na plataforma ArcGIS;
  • Capacidade de análise crítica de especificações de sistemas e negócios;
  • Programação orientada a objetos;
  • Análise de Sistemas;

title: SAP Cloud Architect - SAP Basis
description:
About HCLTech
HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.
To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit you an experienced SAP Basis Consultant ready to take the next step in your career? Join our Cloud Architect Advisory (CAA) team as a SAP Cloud Architect, where you'll guide customers through their SAP RISE journey and shape the future of enterprise landscapes.
About the Role
As a SAP Cloud Architect, you’ll be the strategic advisor for customers transitioning to the SAP RISE platform. This customer-facing role involves planning, designing, and presenting SAP landscape architectures tailored to each client’s needs and hyperscaler preferences (AWS, Azure, GCP). You’ll collaborate closely with SAP Sales and Account Executives to ensure technical accuracy and optimal design.
Note: This is a purely architectural role—no hands-on implementation required. What You’ll Gain
Exposure to cutting-edge SAP technologies: S/4HANA, HANA DB, MDG, Ariba, Salesforce, and more.Access to SAP’s internal training and learning resources.Experience across multiple industries and customer landscapes.A unique opportunity to work on diverse architecture setups not typically available in standard SAP Basis roles.

title: Process Optimization Partner
description:
About the Role


The Process Optimization Partner plays a key role in transforming the People Team’s operations through technology, automation, and intelligent systems. You’ll analyse workflows, identify inefficiencies, and design scalable solutions that enhance the employee and stakeholder experience. This role blends strategic problem-solving with hands-on implementation, leveraging AI tools, process automation, chatbot systems, and dynamic knowledge bases to optimize how the People Team operates.


Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate, document, and improve People Team workflows across the employee lifecycle (recruiting, onboarding, development, engagement, and offboarding).
  • Identify automation opportunities using tools like Zapier, Workato, Power Automate, or internal HRIS systems.
  • Partner with HR stakeholders to reduce manual work, streamline approvals, and improve process accuracy.
  • Implement and monitor AI-driven workflows that enhance response times and reduce operational bottlenecks.
  • Design and maintain AI-powered chatbots to handle routine HR and general support inquiries, FAQs, and employee self-service needs.
  • Continuously analyse chatbot performance to improve accuracy, tone, and efficiency using feedback loops and analytics.
  • Collaborate with IT and data teams to ensure proper integration between HR systems and conversational AI platforms.
  • Build and manage a centralized HR knowledge base that supports employees, managers, and the People Team.
  • Develop structured documentation practices to ensure consistency and ease of information retrieval.
  • Implement taxonomy and tagging systems that enable quick search and smart recommendations.
  • Define and track key metrics related to process efficiency, automation adoption, and employee experience.
  • Use data and feedback to prioritize initiatives and communicate impact to leadership.
  • Stay current on emerging HR technologies, AI trends, and automation best practices.


Qualifications

  • 3–5+ years of experience in HR operations, process improvement, or business automation.
  • Strong understanding of HR workflows, systems, and employee experience design.
  • Hands-on experience with automation platforms (Zapier, Boomi, etc.) and/or AI assistants or chatbot builders (e.g. ChatGPT Enterprise, etc.)
  • Familiarity with HRIS platforms (HiBob, Workday, or similar).
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to translate strategy into execution.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with a collaborative and analytical mindset.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Hubspot CRM.
  • Exposure to AI prompt engineering, knowledge management, or digital transformation initiatives.
  • Passion for creating intuitive, efficient, and employee-friendly systems.


Success in This Role Looks Like

  • The People Team operates with greater speed, accuracy, and consistency.
  • Employees and managers can easily find answers through AI chatbots and a robust knowledge base.
  • Manual, repetitive tasks are reduced or eliminated through automation.
  • Continuous improvement becomes a core capability of the People function.

title: Desenvolvedor SAP ABAP Fiori
description:
Desenvolvedor Sênior ABAP / Fiori

Local: 100% remoto

Regime: PJ ou Coop

Nível: Sênior


Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Sênior ABAP / Fiori para atuar em projetos estratégicos de modernização e evolução tecnológica no ecossistema SAP S/4HANA e SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) .

O profissional será responsável por desenvolver soluções modernas utilizando ABAP Cloud e RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) integradas a SAP Fiori / UI5 , aplicando boas práticas de clean core e arquitetura extensível.

Além das iniciativas mais modernas, é importante que o profissional possua base sólida em ABAP Clássico , garantindo flexibilidade para atuar em demandas tradicionais quando necessário.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver aplicações e extensões com ABAP Cloud / RAP integradas a SAP Fiori / UI5 .
  • Implementar e manter serviços OData, CDS Views e AMDPs para consumo em interfaces Fiori.
  • Trabalhar em ambiente SAP S/4HANA e SAP BTP , aplicando conceitos de clean core e extensibilidade .
  • Apoiar arquitetos e consultores funcionais na definição e entrega de soluções técnicas.
  • Garantir performance, segurança e qualidade de código nas entregas.
  • Contribuir com revisões de código, boas práticas e mentoria técnica para o time.
  • Atuar também, quando necessário, em demandas ABAP Clássico , mantendo soluções legadas e promovendo sua evolução gradativa para o novo modelo.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • 5+ anos de experiência em desenvolvimento ABAP , com domínio de ABAP Clássico e ABAP Cloud .
  • Experiência sólida com RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) .
  • Domínio de SAP Fiori / SAP UI5 e Fiori Elements .
  • Conhecimento em CDS Views , OData Services , AMDPs e integrações RESTful .
  • Experiência com SAP S/4HANA e ferramentas modernas de desenvolvimento (Eclipse ADT, Git, transportes em BTP ).
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação e trabalho colaborativo em times ágeis.


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model) .
  • Experiência com SAP BTP , extensões side-by-side e integrações em nuvem.
  • Certificação SAP ABAP for Cloud ou SAP BTP.
  • Experiência em S/4HANA Cloud (Public ou Private Edition) .

title: Sr. FP&A
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Sr. Senior Finance Analyst, Planning, Modeling & Strategy (Sr. FP&A Analyst) to join our team to work for a top 10 US Insurance Carrier.


Our Client is one of the United States’ largest insurers, providing a wide range of insurance and financial services products with gross written premiums well over US$25 Billion (P&C). They proudly serve more than 10 million U.S. households with more than 19 million individual policies across all 50 states through the efforts of over 48,000 exclusive and independent agents and nearly 18,500 employees. Finally, our Client is part of one the largest Insurance Groups in the world.


As a Sr. FP&A Analyst, you will play a key role in driving the financial planning and analysis function by providing critical insights and developing complex financial models to support strategic decision-making. You will be responsible for reporting performance-related financial results across various entities, managing forecasting, and ensuring validation and reporting for specific processes. This role requires a deep understanding of financial processes, data analytics, and industry dynamics, particularly within the insurance sector. You will collaborate with business owners to evaluate strategic initiatives and present findings to the CFO for approval. Additionally, you will oversee control and sign-off processes, manage presentation and management reports, and ensure their ongoing relevance.


Locations: Brazil, Argentina, and Mexico.


Requirements

  • 4 to 6 years of related experience
  • Work Experience in Insurance Companies required (preferred: P&C Insurance, but Life Insurance background is also acceptable)
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Actuarial Science, Economics, Administration, Finance, or a related field.
  • Fluency in English


Business Skills

  • Database / BI Apps / Financial Modeling: Advanced (Forecasting/planning/Business Case Modeling)


Software / Tool Skills

  • SQL (intermediate)
  • Excel (Advanced)
  • Power BI (Intermediate)
  • SAP Analytics Cloud (desirable)


Please note that Resumes must be presented in English.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • Career development and training opportunities
  • Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office-based)
  • Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group
  • Private Health Insurance
  • Pension Plan
  • Paid Time Off
  • Training & Development
  • Performance Bonus

Note: Benefits differ based on employee level



About Capgemini

Capgemini is a global leader in partnering with companies to transform and manage their business by harnessing the power of technology. The Group is guided everyday by its purpose of unleashing human energy through technology for an inclusive and sustainable future. It is a responsible and diverse organization of over 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong 55-year heritage and deep industry expertise, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to address the entire breadth of their business needs, from strategy and design to operations, fueled by the fast evolving and innovative world of cloud, data, AI, connectivity, software, digital engineering and platforms. The Group €22.5 billion in revenues in 2023

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
About the company:


Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:

As a Senior Software Engineer you will be an active hands-on contributor as well as an influencer for our technical direction. You will be able to contribute to various initiatives as well as provide feedback through code reviews and pairing. We are especially excited about you if you are enthusiastic about working in the luxury retail/e-commerce space or if you are passionate about our mission of sustainability in creating a circular economy for high-end goods.


- Develop using interesting technologies -- Elixir, Ruby, React, Typescript, GraphQL, Kafka, AWS/Lambda, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB - Have input into design and architectural decisions that will shape the future of our software systems - Mentor, actively participate in code reviews, and pair up with a team member to work together on features - Act as a strong partner to product and engineering management


✅ Skills/Experience - Minimum Requirements:

- 7+ years of web application development experience with a track record of successfully shipping consumer or business facing products - Experience in writing reliable and maintainable code, reusable components and component libraries that may be used by many other engineers

- Experience with any of Elixir, Erlang, Ruby, Javascript, NextJs, or another programming language

- Passionate about testing practices and continuous improvement

- Familiarity with common programming tools such as IDEs, RESTful APIs, Git repositories, TypeScript, version control software, and remote deployment tools

- Familiarity with event based architectures, database fundamentals and GraphQL

- Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills

- Curiosity about retail/e-commerce, the high-end consignment market, and/or how to create a sustainable, circular economy for luxury goods


Preferred Requirements: - Experience with Javascript, HTML, CSS, and React - Experience with GraphQL - Experience building microservices - Experience building eCommerce platforms - Experience working with a CMS, especially Prismic - Any experience with mobile development for iOS and/or Android


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Engenheiro de vendas
description:
Empresa: LoopGlobal
Local: Brasil (Atuação Nacional)
Modelo: Híbrido | Disponibilidade para viagens
Sobre a LoopGlobal
A LoopGlobal é um ecossistema industrial formado por quatro pilares estratégicos:
LoopZero – Engenharia, simulação de processos (MAGMASOFT), desenvolvimento de projetos e soluções avançadas para moldes e injeção.
LoopParts – Comercialização de máquinas e equipamentos para fundição de alumínio, injeção, automação e usinagem.
LoopService – Assistência técnica, start-up, manutenção e otimização de células de injeção.
LoopAcademy – Treinamentos técnicos e capacitação profissional para fundição e injeção de metais.
Nosso propósito é entregar soluções completas para o setor de fundição e injeção de alumínio, combinando tecnologia, engenharia, alta performance e atendimento de excelência.
---
Descrição da Vaga
Buscamos um Engenheiro de Vendas para atuar no setor de injeção de alumínio e automação industrial, com foco em prospectar, desenvolver e gerenciar oportunidades comerciais junto a fundições, injetoras e empresas do segmento metalmecânico.
O profissional será responsável por identificar necessidades técnicas, propor soluções completas (máquinas, células, periféricos, automações, simulações e serviços) e conduzir as negociações até o fechamento.
---
Responsabilidades Principais
Atuação Comercial
Prospectar novos clientes no setor de fundição e injeção de alumínio.
Gerenciar carteira de clientes, mantendo relacionamento contínuo.
Elaborar propostas técnicas e comerciais de máquinas, células completas e soluções de automação.
Realizar apresentações técnicas e reuniões com tomadores de decisão.
Acompanhar indicadores de vendas, margens e projeções comerciais.
Atuação Técnica
Compreender processos de injeção de alumínio (alta pressão).
Interpretar desenhos, projetos e necessidades de células de produção.
Sugerir melhorias técnicas, automações e soluções customizadas.
Interagir com engenharia interna (LoopZero) para validação técnica via MAGMASOFT.
Participar de start-ups, FATs e visitas técnicas quando necessário.
---
Requisitos
Formação
Engenharia Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Produção, Automação ou áreas correlatas.
Experiência
Vivência no setor de injeção de alumínio (HPDC) ou fundição.
Conhecimento em equipamentos como:
Injetoras de alumínio
Fornos
Robôs e automações
Periféricos (dosadoras, termorreguladores, rebarbadores, etc.)
Habilidades Técnicas
Leitura e interpretação de desenho técnico.
Noções de automação industrial (robôs, sensores, manipuladores, células).
Conhecimento de processos: dosagem, ciclo de injeção, extração, resfriamento, metalurgia.
Diferencial: Familiaridade com simulação MAGMASOFT.
Habilidades Comerciais
Comunicação consultiva.
Negociação e relacionamento.
Organização e gestão de pipeline.
Autonomia para visitas e viagens.
---
Benefícios
Remuneração fixa + variável agressiva por performance.
Suporte técnico completo da equipe LoopZero e LoopService.
Treinamentos pela LoopAcademy.
Oportunidade de atuar com marcas de referência em máquinas e tecnologias.
Crescimento estruturado dentro do ecossistema LoopGlobal.
---
Perfil Ideal
Buscamos alguém técnico, comunicativo e orientado a resultados, que domine o ambiente de chão de fábrica e saiba transformar conhecimento técnico em soluções comerciais de alto valor agregado.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Senior Accountant


Remote – Brazil


*Applications will only be considered with CVs submitted in English.


Company Overview


Sphise is a global outsourcing partner, helping international companies build and manage high-performing teams worldwide.

Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Accountant to join their dynamic team.


Position Overview


As a Senior Accountant, you will play a critical role in ensuring financial accuracy and operational excellence across our international finance team. You will take ownership of complex reconciliations, advanced transaction coding, and key components of the month-end close, contributing directly to the integrity of our financial reporting.

Using your analytical mindset, technical expertise, and strong understanding of accounting principles, you will resolve discrepancies, support audits, guide junior staff, and help improve internal processes. Your ability to collaborate across departments, communicate clearly, and manage priorities will be essential as you handle AP/AR escalations, review expenses, and maintain high standards of compliance.

This position offers the opportunity to work in a structured, international environment with clear responsibilities, strong team collaboration, and room for continued professional growth.


Key Responsibilities

  • Transaction Reconciliation: Perform and review complex transaction reconciliations in QuickBooks Online; identify and resolve discrepancies independently.
  • Advanced Transaction Coding: Accurately classify and code complex transactions, including accruals, prepaids, and multi-department allocations in compliance with accounting standards.
  • Financial Reporting Support: Assist in preparing monthly financial statements and supporting schedules; contribute to month-end close processes.
  • Expense Management: Review and approve expense reports for accuracy and policy compliance; provide guidance to staff on expense procedures.
  • Accounts Payable/Receivable: Handle escalated AP/AR issues, manage aging reports, assist with collection efforts, and maintain vendor relationships.
  • Journal Entry Preparation: Prepare and post standard and adjusting journal entries; maintain supporting documentation.
  • Process Improvement: Recommend improvements to accounting procedures and help implement best practices for efficiency.
  • Audit Support: Prepare requested audit documentation and schedules; serve as a key contact for auditor inquiries.
  • Junior Staff Support: Provide guidance and answer questions from junior accounting team members as needed.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Strong proficiency in QuickBooks Online (QBO) and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Solid understanding of GAAP and accounting principles.
  • Excellent attention to detail with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks effectively.
  • Strong communication skills for working with various departments and external contacts.


Preferred Experience

  • 4-6 years of progressive accounting experience.
  • Experience with month-end close processes and financial reporting.
  • Background in small-to-mid-sized business accounting environments.
  • Familiarity with expense management tools and multiple accounting software platforms.
  • Experience training or mentoring junior staff members.
  • Strong English Skills.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

Bueno Law, a purpose-driven immigration law firm, is expanding our marketing team, and we’re looking for an exceptional video editor to enhance and elevate our content across YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook.


Your videos will play a key role in helping people find the help they need — while driving lead traffic and brand visibility.

  • Your work will help us change the lives of thousands of immigrants in the U.S.

title: Databricks Data Engineer
description:
Databricks Data Engineer

Fully Remote Contract


We’re looking for a hands-on Databricks Data Engineer with strong experience building scalable data pipelines using Spark, PySpark, SQL, and Delta Lake. This role focuses on ingesting data from multiple sources, transforming it for analytics, and publishing high-quality datasets and visualizations.


Responsibilities:

• Build and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines in Databricks using PySpark, Spark SQL, and Delta Lake.

• Ingest, clean, and transform data from diverse sources (APIs, SQL databases, cloud storage, SAP/legacy systems, streaming).

• Develop reusable pipeline frameworks, data validation logic, and performance-tuned transformations.

• Design curated datasets and deliver insights through Power BI dashboards.

• Implement best practices for lakehouse development, orchestration, and version control.

• Troubleshoot pipeline performance issues and ensure data accuracy, reliability, and quality.


Required Skills:

• Strong hands-on Databricks experience (Spark, PySpark, Delta Lake).

• Advanced SQL for large-scale data processing.

• Experience integrating data from multiple structured and unstructured sources.

• Solid understanding of distributed computing, performance tuning, and debugging Spark jobs.

• Power BI (reports, models, DAX preferred).

• Experience with CI/CD pipelines in an Azure environment


Nice to Have:

• Experience with data quality frameworks, Lakehouse monitoring, or DQX

• Knowledge of Airflow, ADF, IoT, Kafka or other tools is a plus

• Experience with SAP data is a plus.

title: Engenheiro(a) De Software Backend Pleno - Ruby on Rails
description:
O Grupo Smart Fit é muito mais do que a maior rede de academias da América Latina e o maior empregador de profissionais de educação física do mundo. Somos um verdadeiro ecossistema focado em bem-estar e saúde, impactando a vida de milhares de pessoas todos os dias.


Estamos em mais de 15 países, com mais de 1.800 unidades, e temos o prazer de atender mais de 5,2 milhões de alunos. Nossa equipe de 15 mil colaboradores está sempre a mil, trazendo novas ideias e inovações. Desde que abrimos nossa capital em 2021, aceleramos nossa missão de transformar vidas com soluções de fitness e saúde.


Temos várias marcas no nosso portfólio, como Bio Ritmo, Smart Fit, Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, One Pilates, Velocity, Kore TotalPass e Nation CT. Além disso, oferecemos produtos digitais como Queima Diária, Smart Fit Nutri e Smart Fit Coach. Estamos sempre procurando novas formas de integrar tecnologia e inovação para ajudar você a ter um estilo de vida mais ativo e saudável. E aí, topa o desafio junto com a gente?


O que nos move todos os dias?

Somos parte da mudança, transformando o cenário e trazendo mais qualidade para a vida de quem tá junto com a gente. Cada gotinha de suor é uma prova do nosso compromisso em inspirar e motivar todo mundo que quer uma vida mais ativa e saudável. A cada dia, começamos nossa jornada com aquecimento total, prontos para alcançar novos objetivos e viver o máximo.


O(A) Engenheiro(a) De Software Backend Pleno - Ruby será responsável por:

Implementação de Soluções

  • Escrever e implementar código conforme requisitos.
  • Garantir qualidade e usabilidade do produto.
  • Testar e depurar em diferentes ambientes.
  • Contribuir em decisões de arquitetura e design.
  • Revisar código para manter padrões de qualidade.
  • Integrar componentes de software.
  • Estimar tarefas junto ao Líder Técnico e PM, utilizando métricas da equipe.


Sustentação dos Sistemas

  • Resolver chamados (erros e dúvidas).
  • Executar scripts e relatórios de apoio.
  • Garantir segurança e privacidade dos dados com apoio e revisão dos líderes e pares.
  • Participar de war rooms com TL e/ou PM.
  • Atuar pela estabilidade do sistema com SRE e TL, respondendo a alertas e prevenindo falhas.


Itens essenciais que não podem faltar no seu kit:

  • 3 a 5 anos de experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento backend com Ruby on Rails em ambiente de produção.
  • Vivência em arquitetura de sistemas web escaláveis, considerando boas práticas de design, organização de código e manutenção de projetos de longo prazo.
  • Conhecimento sólido em modelagem de dados relacionais e otimização de queries SQL, especialmente em bancos como PostgreSQL ou MySQL.
  • Proficiência em ActiveRecord, ActionCable, ActionMailer e background jobs.
  • Experiência com performance tuning e estratégias para alta escalabilidade.
  • Práticas de testes automatizados (RSpec, Minitest, FactoryBot, etc.).


Infraestrutura e DevOps:

  • Experiência com Docker para containerização de aplicações.
  • Vivência em AWS com serviços como ECS, RDS, S3, CloudWatch, ElasticSearch e Redis.
  • Conhecimento de CI/CD (preferencialmente GitHub Actions, GitLab CI ou similares).


Monitoramento e Observabilidade:

  • Capacidade de configurar e interpretar métricas de APM e erros.
  • Experiência com ferramentas como New Relic, Datadog, Sentry ou similares.


Integrações e Comunicação entre Sistemas:

  • Experiência com serviços de mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS, Sidekiq ou similares).
  • Boas práticas em comunicação entre sistemas distribuídos (eventos assíncronos, retries, idempotência).
  • Experiência em background jobs, com foco em throughput, concorrência e resiliência.


Performance e Boas Práticas:

  • Experiência em otimização de aplicações web (tempo de resposta, uso de cache, indexação de banco).
  • Domínio em boas práticas de programação (Clean Code, SOLID, design patterns).
  • Conhecimentos de segurança de aplicações web (OWASP Top 10, autenticação, criptografia).


Desejável :

  • Experiência em integração com gateways de pagamento (ex: Stripe, Adyen, Pagar.me, Cielo, Stone, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de protocolos de autenticação e segurança (OAuth2, JWT, TLS, assinatura de mensagens).
  • Vivência com conciliação de transações financeiras e tratamento de falhas em fluxos críticos (reprocessamento seguro, antifraude, consistência de dados).


Cuidados com a nossa gente:

Mantemos um ambiente descontraído, onde cada ideia conta. Na base da colaboração e criatividade, a gente está sempre evoluindo e de olho nas tendências que movem o mundo fitness


Aqui é tudo sobre o "porquê" fazemos o que fazemos. Apesar de sermos o maior Grupo de academias da América Latina, sabemos que a saúde e o bem-estar devem ser integral.

title: Culinary Instructor
description:
Key Responsibilities :

1 Culinary Training & Development :

◦ Develop and execute the ship’s overall Culinary Training & Development strategy for all Culinary crew members with 2 or fewer stripes.

◦ Ensure understanding and delivery of the company’s service standards, training materials, operational practices, and rating systems for the Culinary Department.

◦ Conduct relevant training and follow-up audits to ensure these standards are being met consistently.

2 Collaboration with Senior Culinary Leadership :

◦ Assist the Executive Chef and Executive Sous Chef in identifying crew members with the potential for career advancement.

◦ Collaborate with leadership to evaluate crew members who may not meet the required skill set or attitude and determine their future role within the team.

3 Coaching & Staff Development :

◦ Provide ongoing training on company standards and best practices to all culinary employees.

◦ Conduct role-play sessions and hands-on training for crew members at their respective workstations.

◦ Offer constructive feedback during coaching sessions and performance audits.

4 Training Scheduling & Reporting :

◦ Create daily training schedules and feedback reports, presenting them to the Executive Chef.

◦ Organize and execute daily daytime training sessions (45 minutes per group) for crew members on port days, ensuring relevant performance, revenue, and ratings data inform participant selection.

◦ Conduct nightly follow-up performance audits and provide feedback to the crew members and the Executive Chef.

5 Performance Audits & One-on-One Coaching :

◦ Conduct performance audits and coaching sessions during sea days, providing feedback to both crew members and management.

◦ Identify low performers and work with the Executive Chef to create improvement plans for those who may require additional training or support.

6 Mentorship for Senior Staff :

◦ Coach and mentor Chef de Cuisine, Sous Chefs, and Chef de Partie on effectively conducting training sessions, including facility setup, session flow, feedback delivery, and session evaluation.


Qualifications:

Candidate should work as a culinary teacher or instructor in a culinary academy or institute.

Strong background in training and development, teaching, and communications.

Possesses culinary expertise, formal education, and practical experience in the culinary field.

Having culinary training and certificates is a plus.

title: Culinary Instructor
description:
Key Responsibilities :

1 Culinary Training & Development :

◦ Develop and execute the ship’s overall Culinary Training & Development strategy for all Culinary crew members with 2 or fewer stripes.

◦ Ensure understanding and delivery of the company’s service standards, training materials, operational practices, and rating systems for the Culinary Department.

◦ Conduct relevant training and follow-up audits to ensure these standards are being met consistently.

2 Collaboration with Senior Culinary Leadership :

◦ Assist the Executive Chef and Executive Sous Chef in identifying crew members with the potential for career advancement.

◦ Collaborate with leadership to evaluate crew members who may not meet the required skill set or attitude and determine their future role within the team.

3 Coaching & Staff Development :

◦ Provide ongoing training on company standards and best practices to all culinary employees.

◦ Conduct role-play sessions and hands-on training for crew members at their respective workstations.

◦ Offer constructive feedback during coaching sessions and performance audits.

4 Training Scheduling & Reporting :

◦ Create daily training schedules and feedback reports, presenting them to the Executive Chef.

◦ Organize and execute daily daytime training sessions (45 minutes per group) for crew members on port days, ensuring relevant performance, revenue, and ratings data inform participant selection.

◦ Conduct nightly follow-up performance audits and provide feedback to the crew members and the Executive Chef.

5 Performance Audits & One-on-One Coaching :

◦ Conduct performance audits and coaching sessions during sea days, providing feedback to both crew members and management.

◦ Identify low performers and work with the Executive Chef to create improvement plans for those who may require additional training or support.

6 Mentorship for Senior Staff :

◦ Coach and mentor Chef de Cuisine, Sous Chefs, and Chef de Partie on effectively conducting training sessions, including facility setup, session flow, feedback delivery, and session evaluation.


Qualifications:

Candidate should work as a culinary teacher or instructor in a culinary academy or institute.

Strong background in training and development, teaching, and communications.

Possesses culinary expertise, formal education, and practical experience in the culinary field.

Having culinary training and certificates is a plus.

description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Atuação em uma empresa de grande porte do setor financeiro , com presença nacional e internacional , em um ambiente moderno, colaborativo e orientado a dados .

title: DESENVOLVEDOR NODEJS PL - REMOTO
description:
A SOMOS Educação é um dos principais grupos de educação básica do Brasil, oferecendo uma ampla variedade de soluções educacionais. Nossos serviços incluem sistemas de ensino, editoras, soluções de ensino complementares e uma plataforma tecnológica de aprendizado digital e e-commerce. Com isso, nos apresentamos como parceiros integrais das escolas.


Entre as marcas que compõem o nosso grupo estão Anglo, PH, Plurall, Líder em Mim e outras. Nossa missão é transformar o ecossistema das escolas privadas, combinando educação e gestão de alta qualidade com base na neurociência e na tecnologia em larga escala. Além disso, buscamos liderar as escolas no processo de transformação digital, visando ser o principal agente de reinvenção da educação para o aluno e a escola do século XXI.


Para cumprir essa missão e entregar o melhor para as nossas escolas, baseamos nosso trabalho em valores fundamentais. Valorizamos a autonomia e o apoio, o bem-estar, a excelência, a liderança e a inovação em nossa rotina de trabalho. Somos o único grupo educacional classificado como uma das Melhores Empresas para se trabalhar, Great Place to Work – GPTW.



Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Neste desafio você irá:

• Atuar, em conjunto com demais engenheiros, na construção de serviços de alta performance e escalabilidade;

• Planejar e arquitetar novas features, bem como sustentar e refatorar as existentes, considerando os requisitos técnicos e do negócio, com integração com demais áreas;

• Trabalhar em um ambiente ágil dividido em squads e tribos, sendo comunicativo e participativo do dia a dia de desenvolvimento;

• Realizar entregáveis com qualidade, com código limpo, de fácil manutenção e forte atuação junto ao time de qualidade;


Requisitos e qualificações:

O que esperamos:

• Proficiência em NodeJs;

• Conhecimento em TypeScript;

• Experiência em construção de APIs REST ou GraphQL;

• Experiência com banco de dados relacionais: MySQL ou PostgreSQL;

• Experiência com banco de dados não relacionais: MongoDB ou DynamoDB;

• Conhecimento em testes unitários;

• Experiência com versionamento de código utilizando GIT.

• Graduação completa ou incompleta em Ciência da computação, Sistemas de informação ou áreas afins


Diferenciais:

• Conhecimento em NestJS

• Ambiente e recursos AWS;

• Processo de CI/CD (Git Hub Actions)

• Vivência com boas práticas de desenvolvimento (clean code, clean architecture, TDD e BDD);

• Experiência com metodologias ágeis;

• Implementar e manter fluxos de integração de dados através de filas (bull, sqs, rabbitmq, kafka);

• Experiência com aplicações de alto tráfego de informações;

• Conhecimento em Firebase/Firestore.

• Conhecimento em engenharia de prompt



O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.
  • Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.


Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
  • Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.
  • Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.
  • Conexa: Atendimento psicológico gratuito para cuidar da sua saúde mental.
  • Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.
  • Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.


Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

description:
Você possui experiência atuando em Educação Corporativa?

Por isso, a área de Educação Corporativa tem um papel estratégico: é responsável por planejar, desenvolver e implementar projetos e estratégias de desenvolvimento organizacional , sempre com foco na evolução contínua dos nossos colaboradores e líderes.

O conhecimento e a aplicação da metodologia 6Ds serão considerados diferenciais importantes para garantir que o aprendizado gere impacto real no desempenho e nos resultados da organização.


Se você é apaixonado por aprendizagem, inovação e quer fazer parte de uma cooperativa que valoriza o desenvolvimento das pessoas, essa é a sua oportunidade!

title: Enterprise Network Engineer
description:
Enterprise Network Engineer

We’re looking for someone who knows their way around large-scale networks, understands complex routing and switching setups, and can walk into a customer conversation with confidence.

What you’ll handle

You will install, configure, test, troubleshoot, and sometimes design network solutions using Cisco routing and switching platforms. The job involves direct customer interaction, so you need to be comfortable explaining your thinking to both engineers and leadership teams.

Must-have skills

  • Strong understanding of routing and switching technologies: IGP, OSPF, EGP, BGP, STP, RSTP, VTP, VSS, vPC, vDC, MSTP, LACP, VLAN
  • Solid experience with LAN switch technologies including STP, RSTP, VTP, VSS, MSTP, LACP, VLAN, VXLAN-EVPN
  • Hands-on experience with Cisco platforms: ISR 800/1900/2900/3900/4000 series, ASR 1000, Catalyst 6500, 6800, 4500, 3850
  • Background in installation, configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and solution design across routers and switches
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain network strategy to customers and internal teams
  • Comfortable in client-facing situations and capable of driving conversations across cross-functional groups

Nice to have

  • Experience leading customer workshops, creating HLD and LLD documents
  • Service Provider domain exposure: XR, ASR9K, MPLS, BGP, BNG, Segment Routing
  • Familiarity with SDA, SD-WAN, or ACI
  • Experience with Nexus switches, UCS, or Hyperflex
  • Network automation skills using Python, Ansible, Go, or Splunk

Education and Certifications

  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
  • CCNA required
  • CCNP is an advantage
  • CCIE Enterprise is preferred

title: Sr. Technical Customer Success Analyst
description:
Title: Sr. Customer Support Analyst

Business Unit: Graphic Communications

Location: Brazil, Remote


Graphic Communications( a CAI Division) is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for print industries. Graphic Communications ’s integrated and automated software offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With several offices worldwide, and over thirty-years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the printing industries, it is our deeply held philosophy that Graphic Communications succeeds when our customers thrive. For more information, visit us at


As a Sr. Customer Support Analyst , you will troubleshoot complex customer requests, manage the global support queue and backlog, and ensure exceptional, timely service for our valued customers. Reporting directly to the Sr. Manager, Customer Success , you will play a crucial role in driving customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term success.

In this role, you will combine your technical expertise, analytical thinking, and customer-focused mindset to deliver high-quality solutions to critical support issues. You will act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, collaborating closely with internal teams to diagnose, resolve, and prevent recurring issues.


Your key responsibilities include delivering specialized technical solutions to escalated support cases, providing a proactive, personalized customer experience, and strengthening the partnership between the Customer Support Team and Graphic Communication’s clients through technical excellence and accountability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Answer incoming telephone calls and open cases in Salesforce, identifying customers, populating case details, and confirming data accuracy.
  • Monitor the Global Support queue and accept Salesforce cases in priority sequence.
  • Review case priority and maintain strict adherence to SLA requirements based on severity and impact.
  • Troubleshoot customer-reported issues, identify root causes, and provide timely solutions via case updates, calls, or screen-sharing sessions.
  • Provide customer support via email, Teams, and telephone using discretion, experience, and technical judgment.
  • Escalate or re-route cases to appropriate Tier 2 or Tier 3 teams after thorough investigation while maintaining SLA compliance.
  • Allocate resources, systems, and solutions to ensure efficient issue resolution.
  • Identify customers’ operational and business challenges, guiding them and the Graphic Communications team toward effective resolutions.
  • Document and submit solutions to the knowledge base with complete technical and procedural details.
  • Close cases with accurate and comprehensive resolution documentation.
  • Collaborate closely with R&D and Services teams to replicate and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Test, analyze, organize, and report progress on ongoing customer cases.
  • Ensure accountability and progress tracking through Salesforce reporting and analytics.
  • Manage and prioritize active support cases within your queue while maintaining strong communication with customers.
  • Make informed case routing decisions, escalating appropriately based on technical complexity.
  • Follow up with clients on outstanding queries and provide proactive updates.
  • Notify clients about new software releases, coordinating with Marketing to ensure customers are informed of relevant fixes and improvements.
  • Collaborate with Tiered Support peers and Development teams for environment setup, database capture, and other technical tasks as required.


Technical Troubleshooting Responsibilities

  • Use Chrome Developer Tools (Inspector) to analyze web applications, review network requests, debug front-end issues, and identify JavaScript or API failures.
  • Perform API testing and validation using tools such as Postman or cURL.
  • Conduct IIS and SSL diagnostics to investigate and resolve issues on Windows Application Servers.
  • Configure and troubleshoot Windows ADFS Servers and perform remote diagnostics via VPN, RDP, or similar tools.
  • Assist customers with database backups, migrations, and SQL troubleshooting using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), write scripts, stored procedures, and queries.
  • Utilize network tracing tools (e.g., Wireshark, Fiddler) to diagnose connectivity, latency, or certificate-related issues.
  • Perform log analysis across web, application, and system logs to identify root causes of performance or access issues.
  • Understanding of web deployment and troubleshooting for ASP.NET-based applications and related components.
  • Maintain proficiency in analyzing browser console errors, network calls, and response payloads to pinpoint issues in customer environments.
  • Participate in proactive system health checks, monitoring server performance metrics and application uptime indicators.


Experience Requirements

  • Minimum 8+ years of customer support experience.
  • ERP/MIS background preferred.
  • Print industry knowledge is mandatory.
  • Experience with tools such as Salesforce, JIRA, and Confluence preferred.
  • Strong understanding of support operations and troubleshooting methodologies.
  • Ability to solve problems efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Self-starter with the ability to work with minimal guidance.
  • Confident in delegating tasks and providing peer guidance.
  • Willing to work in shifts as required.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Strong documentation and organizational abilities.
  • Data analysis skills (reports, dashboards, and metrics).
  • Proficient in general computing, internet research, and email communication.
  • Understanding of web development, SSO, Active Directory, and SSL.
  • Hands-on experience with VPN configuration, network management, and SQL scripting.


Education

  • Degree in Technology, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent hands-on experience in customer support and enterprise systems.
  • Strong understanding of software troubleshooting, printing workflows, and IT infrastructure preferred.

title: Cyber Security Manager (Blockchain & Tokenization)
description:
Security Manager

Location: Americas, Remote


About Us

Pointsville is an end-to-end alternative asset factory, offering solutions that bridge the gap between emerging digital financial technologies and traditional asset classes. We specialize in Alternative Asset Digitalization and Loyalty Innovation, empowering organizations to unlock new value through tokenization, stablecoin infrastructure, and real-world asset integration.


Our globally distributed team of innovators, builders, and thinkers is passionate about the future of finance. Join Pointsville and be part of shaping the future of digital finance!


Overview

We’re looking for a hands-on security leader who can build, manage, and scale Pointsville’s security and compliance programs. This role is ideal for someone capable of designing enterprise-grade security programs, engineering security tools, and embedding best practices into fast-moving development environments.


What You’ll Do

Security Strategy, Leadership & Program Development

  • Build and lead Pointsville’s global security and compliance function from the ground up.
  • Develop and implement the company-wide security strategy, policies, and frameworks aligned with business and regulatory goals.
  • Conduct organization-wide risk assessments, vulnerability scans, and incident response exercises.
  • Drive security awareness and training programs to strengthen company-wide accountability.
  • Collaborate with executive leadership to ensure security goals align with organizational priorities.


Technical Security Engineering

  • Lead the design and development of advanced security testing and monitoring platforms, including distributed fuzzing systems and validation frameworks.
  • Conduct secure architecture reviews and threat modeling for infrastructure, APIs, smart contracts, and cloud-native services.
  • Integrate Secure SDLC practices into CI/CD pipelines — automating vulnerability discovery, testing, and compliance reporting.
  • Perform deep-dive analysis of vulnerabilities, exploits, and mitigations across web, mobile, and blockchain systems.
  • Partner with Engineering and DevOps to ensure secure-by-design implementation in infrastructure-as-code and deployments.


Cloud, Infrastructure & Data Protection

  • Oversee cloud security architecture (AWS preferred), including network segmentation, IAM, and continuous monitoring.
  • Manage VPNs, multi-region access, and secret management tools (Vault, KMS, etc.).
  • Ensure data privacy and protection measures are embedded in all systems and products.
  • Lead investigations, containment, and response in the event of security incidents or data breaches.


Compliance, Risk & Governance

  • Develop and maintain security compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, and CCPA.
  • Prepare and manage internal and external audits and certifications.
  • Identify, document, and mitigate enterprise security and compliance risks.
  • Establish a “privacy by design” and “security by default” culture in collaboration with legal and product teams.


Communication & Collaboration

  • Serve as the main point of contact for all internal and external security and compliance matters.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Operations to align security controls with business needs.
  • Deliver clear reporting and recommendations to leadership on security posture, incidents, and ongoing improvements.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in security engineering, product security, or infrastructure security roles.
  • Proven track record designing and deploying security tools and frameworks at scale.
  • Deep understanding of cryptography, secure protocols, and key management systems.
  • Expertise in AWS, Docker/Kubernetes, and large-scale distributed systems.
  • Strong knowledge of application security (OWASP, STRIDE, TARA) and vulnerability mitigation.
  • Proficiency in one or more system languages (Java, C, C++, Rust, Go) and one scripting language (Python, Shell).
  • Experience with blockchain and smart contract security preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to automate security controls, conduct penetration testing, and perform design reviews.
  • Strong communication and leadership skills, with experience mentoring engineers and influencing cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in written and spoken English


We are committed to providing equal opportunity for qualified applicants to contract positions, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is a contract opportunity, not a direct employment role.

description:

title: Iteration Video Editor
description:
Who We Are

Mindful Agency is a performance-driven creative team specializing in high-converting Meta ads for top tech brands. We’re looking for an Iterations Editor—someone who can take fully edited 30–60 second Meta ads and generate multiple high-quality variations designed to increase performance, improve hook testing, and expand creative volume.


This role is not standard editing. It requires someone who understands creative iteration as a scientific process: isolating variables, modifying structure and pacing, and generating new variants that give Meta’s algorithm more opportunities to find winners.


What You’ll Do
  • Open existing fully-edited Premiere Pro project files and generate new, distinct iterations of the same ad.
  • Create alternative hooks, shorten or re-structure timelines, adjust pacing, and introduce new punch-in/out moments to increase stopping power.
  • Modify captions, layout, on-screen text, reframing, b-roll timing, and transitions while keeping brand consistency intact.
  • Produce multiple versions of each ad optimized for performance testing (length trims, hook variations, CTA variations).
  • Ensure all variations are export-ready, cleanly organized, and aligned with Mindful Agency’s internal workflow in Notion and Google Drive.
  • Collaborate asynchronously with the creative team to understand each ad’s strategic goal (problem-solution, testimonial, UGC pacing, value prop emphasis).
  • Maintain consistent daily output based on clear production expectations and deliverables.


Requirements
  • Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro (must be comfortable navigating another editor’s timeline, proxies, nests, captions, and media management).
  • Strong understanding of direct-response video editing, ideally with experience in Meta/TikTok ad formats.
  • Ability to identify and modify high-leverage creative variables: hook strength, pacing, text placement, dynamic framing, and overall watch-through optimization.
  • Strong creative instincts paired with a scientific mindset—able to think in terms of tests, variants, and performance hypotheses.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to produce clean, organized sequences that integrate back into our workflow.
  • Fast, reliable communication and ability to work independently across global time zones.
  • Portfolio demonstrating short-form ads or UGC-style edits (required).


Nice-to-Haves
  • Experience with direct-response brands, SaaS, tech, or e-commerce.
  • Familiarity with Meta ad performance patterns (retention curves, thumb-stop theory, hook testing).
  • Motion graphics or caption stylization skills for added variation when needed.


Why Work With Mindful
  • Work with a fast-growing US-based performance agency that values craftsmanship and creativity.
  • Clear workflows, predictable task structure, and objective editing metrics.
  • Long-term opportunity with consistent volume of work.

title: Training and Development Manager
description:
JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role

We’re seeking a results-driven Training & Development Specialist to lead the design and delivery of high impact learning programs across our global organization. The ideal candidate will proactively identify business needs and develop targeted training & development solutions that strengthen employee performance and productivity.


Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end training programs from design to delivery, achieving measurable improvements in performance and productivity.
  • Author and maintain engaging training content for e-learning, virtual, and live sessions, with clear learning objectives and measurable outcomes.
  • Analyze skill gaps and business priorities to develop targeted learning interventions that address performance barriers.
  • Build and implement post-training evaluations and reinforcement micro-learnings to ensure knowledge retention and ensure consistent on-the-job application.
  • Own and continuously improve key KPIs, including time-to-perform, new hire ramp-up time, training completion and application rates, and measurable performance improvements.
  • Develop and scale career development pathways that accelerate internal mobility and strengthen leadership and functional talent pipelines.
  • Partner with business leaders to ensure all learning initiatives are strategically aligned with department goals, driving both capability building and business impact.


Requirements:

  • 8+ years of experience in Training, Learning & Development, or Organizational Development.
  • Strong expertise in instructional design principles and adult learning methodologies; relevant certification preferred.
  • Proven experience with e-learning authoring tools (e.g., Articulate, Rise) and Learning Management Systems (LMS) such as Brightspace.
  • Demonstrated success in delivering and scaling learning programs that drive measurable skill development and business impact.
  • Ability to comprehend complex or technical information and translate it into clear, engaging, and effective training content.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Highly organized, results-driven, and able to work independently in a fast-paced, evolving environment.


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.
